raw_row.name: Dhruva Vutukury
raw_row.What's your level of experience with rob: Throughout high school I’ve been heavily involved in competitive robotics, where I served as team captain and led both the technical and strategic side of our builds. On the software side I have hands on experience writing code in C++, handling things like motor control and sensor integration. On the hardware side I’ve designed and built physical systems using CAD software like Fusion 360 and SolidWorks. Outside of the competition environment I’ve also taken that same builder mentality into hackathons, like at the National Defense Hackathon where our team attempted to reconfigure a drone to run a custom physics engine from scratch, which didn’t fully work out but taught me a lot about the gap between what you design and what actually functions in a real build. So overall I have experience across both the software and hardware sides of robotics, and I’ve had to apply that under real pressure in competition and outside of it.
